meta.title: Fees, prizes and terms
meta.description: Set a competition's fees, its award schemes and the documents people agree to when they register.

adminCompetitionTerms.title: Fees, prizes and terms
adminCompetitionTerms.lead: Saved changes show on the public page straight away.

denied.title: Only competition managers can open this page
denied.body: Ask a super admin for the competition manager role, for all competitions or for this one.

adminCompetitionTerms.unchanged: Nothing changed: that is what was already set.
adminCompetitionTerms.failed: That didn't save. Reload the page and try again.

fees.heading: Fees
fees.lead: Amounts in rupees, as FOA sets them. A fee of 0 means free.
fees.locked: Registration has opened, so the fees are locked.
fees.noParticipation: Choose who takes part on the competition's main form first.
fees.stepUp: Fees are money: pass your second factor again, then save.
fees.paid: A fee for each way of entering

route.individual: Entering on their own, in rupees
route.institution: Through a school or institution, in rupees

errors.route_not_offered: This competition doesn't take entries this way.

awards.heading: Prizes and recognition
awards.lead: Choose how each round recognises its best entries, and any prize for each place.

errors.round_not_offered: This competition doesn't run that round.
errors.band_not_in_scheme: That place isn't in this scheme.

documents.heading: Documents people agree to
documents.lead: Attaching pins the latest published version. Publishing a newer version changes nothing here until you attach again.

state.current: Version {version} attached. It is the latest.

documents.noVersion: Nothing published yet. Staff admins publish it on the consent documents page.
